description: http://127.0.0.1:8081/files/root/.fsapi/v1/stat?path=%2F.gitattributes returns `"mimeType": "application/octet-stream"`, which makes the UI unable to edit the file. This seems to be based on file extension.
resolution: MimeTypeResolver now recognises extension-less/dot-only names and source/config extensions Jetty does not know; core/mime.js has the same table as defence in depth.

description: Right click and copy (either path or name) doesn't result in copying.
resolution: New core/clipboard.js copyText(): navigator.clipboard rejects while the closing menu owns focus, so it falls back to execCommand('copy'); both actions now report success/failure.

description: Double-clicking folders doesn't expand the folders.
resolution: Selection no longer repaints the tree (refreshSelection), so both clicks land on the same row; dblclick also falls back to a hit-test and then to the focused node.

description: Need to add basic code chat.
resolution: New ChatPanel (bottom dock) hosts a POST /modify session in an iframe; 'Code Chat…' action + Mod+Shift+C, and server actions answering with a URL are routed to it instead of a blockable pop-up.

description: Right clicking files shouldn't show folder-specific actions like "open terminal in...".
resolution: Actions may declare hideWhenDisabled; terminal.openHere is folder-only, and file.run / file.download / folder.downloadZip hide when the selection cannot satisfy them.

description: Autofix action should not display for non-executable files.
resolution: ServerTaskActions declares the AutoFix selection as directories only with hideWhenDisabled, and ActionUi forwards that flag through GET /actions.

description: Need to resize code window/terminal split - and collapse terminal especially when no terminal is open.
resolution: Bottom dock splitter now collapses/restores on double-click, the panel collapses itself when the last session exits ('panel:empty'), and toggling the terminal opens a session so the dock is never revealed blank.

description: Add selection-edit actions: edit code with recently used edit prompts.
resolution: 'Edit Selection with AI…' (Mod+Alt+E, editor/selection anchor) offers recent prompts first, persists history, and opens a chat session with the selection quoted into the prompt.

description: When expanding folders, the tiletree view's scroll position gets reset.
resolution: TreeView.paint() saves and restores scrollTop (clear() collapses the scroll height), and selection changes no longer repaint at all.

description: Add a focus-to-currently-edited-file button in the filetree button bar.
resolution: New 'tree.revealActiveFile' command (Mod+Shift+J) with a 🎯 toolbar button, a Go menu entry and a tab context-menu entry.
